in_marathi.name: Nooralam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of the land
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nooralam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nooralam is a Hindi name that means 'Light of the land'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nir', meaning 'light', and 'oora', meaning 'land'. This name is believed to be bestowed upon those who illuminate and bring prosperity to their communities and homelands.
